flags.reason: X_train is all normal samples and those exact same normal samples are also copied into X_test, so training and evaluation are not disjoint.
Aggregation takes idxmax(AUC) over seeds for each dataset/model before computing means, cherry-picking the best seed and leaving reported standard deviations undefined.
The contamination study stacks X_train with X_test even though every normal row is already present in both, then re-splits duplicated rows so identical observations can leak across train and test.
Unconditional breaks exit both dataset loops after their first iteration, so only one of the eight contamination datasets is processed per seed.
The launcher runs model indices 0..10 although ContaminationStudies defines only 10 models (indices 0..9), making every index-10 job fail.
semi_only is forced True while the only CLI action is store_true, so the documented instruction to omit --semi_only cannot enable standard transductive results.
split_index changes only the output directory name; no dataset filtering uses split, so small/medium/high_dim/large outputs all aggregate every dataset.
The claimed seven-model inductive check runs indices 45..50 only, omitting index 51 (KNN_semisup) on every dataset and seed.
The KNN launcher invokes nonexistent Full_experiments.py and index 50 is INNE_semisup rather than KNN_semisup, so it cannot run the advertised target.
The robustness launcher and README require RobustnessStudy.py, but that entry point is absent, so the advertised empirical robustness experiment is not reproducible.
The README advertises AblationStudies.py and four ablation outputs, but the runner is absent.
The aggregation script ends after writing CSV files and contains no plotting code, contradicting the documented Rank_ROC.pdf and Rank_PR.pdf outputs.

Random t is fed only as an auxiliary input while both the training sample and target -batch_x are independent of t, so the alleged time-conditioned flow objective merely trains the network to ignore time.
only_ce_epochs equals total_epochs, making epoch >= only_ce_epochs impossible and disabling DROCC's defining adversarial loss for the entire run.
NormalizingFlowModel is only a bottleneck autoencoder; PlanarFlow, Jacobian likelihoods, and K are never used, so the reported NormalizingFlow baseline is not a normalizing flow.
DDPM reconstruction comments out forward noising and starts the reverse diffusion chain from the clean test sample at a high timestep, violating the sampler's assumed state distribution.
DAGMM uses batch_size=1024 with drop_last=True, so datasets with fewer than 1024 training normals execute zero optimizer steps and are scored by a random model.
test_size and random_state are never used, so the nominal seed-specific data split does not exist and all five runs reuse the same leaked partition.

Seven selected baselines are fit directly on the evaluation matrix including anomalies and scored on those same rows, while the remaining baselines train on normal-only data, yielding incomparable protocols.
The only public score collapses feature residuals to a scalar norm and the repository exposes no feature-contribution/explanation method despite repeatedly claiming feature-wise explanations.
